api_runtime_equivalence.note: The web-only correction rebuilt release tags; OCI provenance identities may differ while the API runtime configuration and filesystem remain identical.

limitations: Browser and restoration checks use analytic synthetic recordings; no new physical acquisition is claimed.
Room2 is a separate already-consumed input regression, not a new estimator evaluation.
The backup contains the observed small database and three retained synthetic acquisitions, not a full-quota recovery benchmark.
Restored authentication uses the in-process Django client and the transferred API runtime; no restored browser or TLS deployment is claimed.
This is an operator-run backup and restoration rehearsal, not a scheduled backup service.
Private account names, project/acquisition identifiers, payloads, paths, database dumps and environment values are excluded.
